title: 職人と現場の仕事
lead: 大工・農家・漁師・パン職人・左官など、職人と現場の仕事をゆるい手描きのタッチで描いた人物素材12点です。求人や会社案内に使えます。
subject_en: Loose hand-drawn style adults working at trades, each ONE person full body with their tools, centred, varied ages and genders, friendly natural faces. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a carpenter planing a wooden board
a farmer holding a basket of vegetables in a field
a fisher pulling a net on a small boat
a baker taking bread out of an oven with a peel
a plasterer smoothing a wall with a trowel
a potter shaping clay on a wheel
a tailor measuring cloth with a tape
a welder in a mask working with sparks
a chef tossing food in a pan
a gardener trimming a hedge with shears
an electrician on a ladder working on wires
a mechanic checking a car engine
